name: Bounce Rate
definition: Share of sessions classified as bounced.
caution: Use the analytics tool’s explicit definition; single-page visits are not universally bounces.

name: Conversion Rate
definition: Eligible users or visits completing a defined action divided by eligible users or visits.
caution: Specify unit, cohort, attribution and conversion window.

name: Landing Page Conversion Rate
definition: Eligible landing-page visitors completing the chosen action divided by eligible visitors.
caution: Separate pages and traffic cohorts; define repeat visits.

name: Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC)
definition: Defined acquisition costs divided by newly acquired customers.
caution: State included costs, timing, customer definition and attribution lag.

name: Cost Per Acquisition (CPA)
definition: Campaign costs divided by attributed target actions.
caution: An action need not be a paying customer; distinguish from CAC.

name: Channel Effectiveness
definition: Comparison of channel outcomes against costs and goals.
caution: A family of measures, not one standard formula; compare retained value.

name: Traffic Source Distribution
definition: Share of eligible traffic attributed to each source.
caution: Define attribution model and unknown/direct traffic.

name: Cost Per Click (CPC)
definition: Advertising spend divided by attributable clicks.
caution: Cheap clicks do not establish customer value.

name: Click-Through Rate (CTR)
definition: Clicks divided by impressions for a defined placement.
caution: Specify total or unique counts; check downstream outcomes.

name: Time to Value (TTV)
definition: Elapsed time from a defined starting event to a meaningful value event.
caution: Report distribution and users who never reach value, not just successful users.

name: Onboarding Completion Rate
definition: Eligible starters completing a defined onboarding flow within a window.
caution: Completion does not necessarily mean achieved value.

name: User Activation Rate
definition: Eligible users reaching a defined value-related milestone within a window.
caution: Validate the milestone’s relationship to value and retention.

name: Trial-to-Paid Conversion Rate
definition: Eligible trials becoming paid within a defined window.
caution: Account for trials still running and consistent cohort timing.

name: First-time User Conversion Rate
definition: First-time users completing a specified action within a window.
caution: Define first-time identity and action.

name: Product Qualified Leads (PQL)
definition: Users meeting documented product-usage qualification rules.
caution: A rule-based count or rate, not automatic proof of purchase intent.

name: Product Qualified Accounts (PQA)
definition: Accounts meeting documented account-level qualification rules.
caution: Define aggregation across users and account eligibility.

name: Daily Active Users (DAU)
definition: Distinct users performing qualifying activity in a day.
caution: Specify activity, timezone and identity deduplication.

name: Monthly Active Users (MAU)
definition: Distinct users performing qualifying activity in a month.
caution: Calendar month and rolling 30 days are different conventions.

name: Stickiness
definition: A stated DAU-to-MAU ratio.
caution: Define the daily statistic and matching window; not suitable for every usage cadence.

name: User Satisfaction (CSAT)
definition: Survey satisfaction measure using a declared scale and aggregation.
caution: Define satisfied responses and denominator; report response bias.

name: Session Length
definition: Elapsed duration of a defined session.
caution: Inactivity timeout and background activity matter; longer can mean friction.

name: Session Frequency
definition: Sessions per user in a defined window.
caution: Specify eligible population and expected use cadence.

name: Feature Usage
definition: Adoption, frequency or depth of a defined feature interaction.
caution: Separate availability, exposure and successful use; no single standard formula.

name: Customer Effort Score (CES)
definition: Survey measure of perceived effort or ease.
caution: Scale wording determines direction; lower is not universally better.

name: Task Success Rate
definition: Successful eligible attempts divided by eligible task attempts.
caution: Define task, success, partial success and assisted attempts.

name: User Feedback Score
definition: A defined aggregation of user ratings.
caution: No universal scale; do not merge incompatible questions or scales.

name: Churn Rate
definition: Share of an eligible starting population lost in a defined period.
caution: Distinguish customer, user-activity and revenue churn; define lost and reactivation.

name: User Retention Rate
definition: Share of an eligible starting cohort meeting a return/value criterion.
caution: State exact-day, rolling or bounded-window convention.

name: Cohort Retention Analysis
definition: Retention compared across groups with a common starting condition.
caution: An analysis method, not a single number; compare equal cohort ages.

name: User Renewal Rate
definition: Eligible contracts or subscriptions renewed divided by those due.
caution: Exclude not-yet-due renewals and define grace periods.

name: Customer Lifetime
definition: Duration of a customer relationship under a defined end condition.
caution: Active relationships are censored; observed duration is not completed lifetime.

name: Customer Health Score
definition: Documented composite of usage, service and relationship signals.
caution: Expose weights, missingness and validation; not an objective universal score.

name: Product Adoption Rate
definition: Eligible users or accounts adopting a product/feature within a window.
caution: Define adoption as meaningful behavior rather than exposure alone.

name: Average Revenue Per Account (ARPA)
definition: Period revenue divided by the consistently defined account base.
caution: State revenue scope, currency, period and average versus ending account count.

name: Customer Lifetime Value (CLV/LTV)
definition: Observed or modeled lifetime revenue or contribution per customer.
caution: Declare revenue versus margin basis, horizon and assumptions; do not infer from thin churn data.

name: Customer Profitability
definition: Customer-attributed revenue less relevant costs under a declared method.
caution: LTV minus CAC and LTV/CAC are different economics measures, not interchangeable profit formulas.

name: Monthly Recurring Revenue (MRR)
definition: Monthly-normalized recurring subscription revenue.
caution: Define discounts, usage components, currency and exclusions; not cash collected.

name: Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR)
definition: Annualized recurring run rate under the chosen policy.
caution: Often 12 times comparable MRR; not guaranteed future revenue or bookings.

name: Expansion Revenue
definition: Added recurring or other defined revenue from existing customers.
caution: Separate upgrades, cross-sells, price changes and new customers.

name: Average Contract Value (ACV)
definition: Average contract value under an explicit annualized or total-value convention.
caution: Do not confuse total contract value with annual value; document one-time charges.

name: Gross Margin
definition: Revenue less cost of revenue; percentage divides that amount by revenue.
caution: Distinguish dollars from percent and follow the applicable cost classification; sales expense is not automatically cost of revenue.

name: Net Revenue Churn
definition: Starting-cohort revenue lost to churn/contraction less expansion, often divided by starting revenue.
caution: Specify reactivation policy; exclude new-customer revenue; can be negative.

name: Net Revenue Retention (NRR)
definition: Starting-cohort recurring revenue retained including expansion/contraction/churn divided by starting recurring revenue.
caution: Exclude new customers; same scope and policies are needed to compare with net revenue churn.

name: Virality Coefficient
definition: Attributed new users generated per originating user in a defined referral cycle.
caution: State invitations and conversion assumptions; cycle time and saturation matter.

name: Customer Referral Rate
definition: Eligible customers making a qualifying referral divided by eligible customers.
caution: Define completed referral versus merely sharing a link.

name: Referral Conversion Rate
definition: Eligible referred prospects becoming qualified active users/customers divided by referred prospects.
caution: Specify conversion event, window and attribution.

name: Net Promoter Score (NPS)
definition: For the standard 0–10 question, percent 9–10 responses minus percent 0–6 responses.
caution: Denominator includes valid 7–8 responses; score is attitude, not observed referral behavior.

name: Lead Time
definition: Elapsed time from an agreed request/commitment point to the agreed completion point.
caution: Choose explicit boundaries; backlog entry is not universal.

name: Time to Market (TTM)
definition: Elapsed time from the chosen idea/opportunity start to customer availability.
caution: Document boundaries and scope; compare equivalent work.

name: Cycle Time
definition: Elapsed time from work start to the defined finished state.
caution: State inclusion of waiting and blocked time; use distributions.

name: Work In Progress (WIP)
definition: Count of items started and not finished at a point in time.
caution: Use consistent workflow boundaries and item granularity.

name: Throughput
definition: Count of finished comparable work items per time unit.
caution: Throughput measures flow, not customer value; do not mix incompatible item sizes blindly.

name: Time to Learn (TTL)
definition: Elapsed time from a question/test starting point to decision-relevant evidence.
caution: Define the learning decision; shipping or collecting events alone is not learning.

name: Work Item Age
definition: Elapsed time since start for an unfinished item.
caution: Use the same start boundary as cycle time; do not count it as completed cycle time.

name: Velocity
definition: Team-estimated work units completed per iteration.
caution: Team-local planning aid; do not compare people/teams or interpret points as value.
